oliver: Heads-up — compliance asked for a self-serve console snapshot flow so small teams can request limited raw logs for fast triage without paging infra. They also want a breakglass path for emergencies. Proposal: console request -> auto-ticket -> requires 1 sec_lead approval (button) OR breakglass with 2FA+justification; breakglass records extra audit fields. Raw TTL=24h, scrubbed copy and attest kept longer. All unwraps must go through kms-proxy. Thoughts?

nina: Console approach is good. Two concerns: 1) approvals must be non-delegable unless explicitly set in ticket meta; 2) breakglass should force an OTP and capture approver name + reason in the audit entry. Also require an automated scrub-run and signed attest before delivering to requesters.

dave: Agree. Add immutable object hashing: compute sha256 for each exported object, store the hash in audit-sink prior to any access. If breakglass used, rotate the CMK post-export and emit an alert to #sec-ops + compliance. Humans never get direct kms:Decrypt.

sec-bot: ticket TKT-2026-900 created by oliver@redwood.com. fields recorded: scope=auth,proxy; raw_window=2026-03-10T00:00Z/2026-03-11T00:00Z; retention_raw_hours=24; breakglass=false. audit_id=a1b2c3.

compliance: retention policy ok: raw=24h, attest=90d, index/metadata=365d. Legal review required if any EU identifiers present. Also require console to surface the audit link and scrub attest in the ticket UI (read-only).

oliver: sample console payload (minimal):
`{ ticket_id: TKT-2026-900, requester: oliver@redwood.com, scope: [auth,proxy], raw_from: 2026-03-10T00:00Z, raw_to: 2026-03-11T00:00Z, retention_raw_hours: 24, approver: sec_lead }`

oliver: infra-run CLI (operator):
`redwood-export --ticket TKT-2026-900 --datasets auth,proxy --from 2026-03-10T00:00Z --to 2026-03-11T00:00Z --out s3://sec-temp/TKT-2026-900/raw/ --encrypt-with-cmk arn:aws:kms:...:key/xxxx --kms-proxy-tag ticket=TKT-2026-900;expiry=2026-03-12T00:00Z`

dave: post-export steps (enforced): 1) scrub-run -> writes attest file s3://sec-temp/TKT-2026-900/attest/scrub.sig (signed), 2) compute sha256 of each object and write to audit-sink with ticket id and actor, 3) delete raw after TTL and emit delete-audit with sha256. If scrub FAIL -> block delivery and escalate to sec+compliance.

nina: RBAC proposal: `console_snapshot_requester` (can open requests only), `console_snapshot_approver` (can approve via console), `export_operator` (infra, can run export CLI). KMS Decrypt only to `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-proxy` with condition kms:RequestTag/ticket == ticket value. Also require `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true` for any principal that can trigger export in prod.

dave: enforcement checklist: ticket must include justification and link to incident id if applicable; console blocks submit if scope contains >7d raw span unless sec+legal approved; every GrantCreate/Unwrap/Retire event must be logged with ticket metadata.

compliance: Please add a console checkbox to require "Contains EU personal data?" If checked, require legal approval before export. Also require retention TTL and delete attest to be searchable in compliance index.

oliver: will add UI changes and open PR for RBAC policy + runbook. I'll include sample terraform snippets for the kms-proxy policy and the console audit link. Will post PR link here for review. Closing unless objections. :lock:
